indication_area: Hepatic veno-occlusive disease (sinusoidal obstruction syndrome) after hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation
moa: Oligonucleotide mixture with profibrinolytic, antithrombotic and endothelial-protective properties

approval_evidence.quote: application_number NDA208114, brand_name DEFITELIO, sponsor JAZZ PHARMS INC, submission_type ORIG, submission_status AP, submission_status_date 20160330 (openFDA Drugs@FDA record)

launch_evidence.quote: We commenced the launch of Defitelio in Europe beginning in Germany and Austria in March 2014 (Jazz Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2014)

series_start_reason: Defitelio's commercial launch began in Germany and Austria in March 2014, the quarter Jazz acquired Gentium (January 23, 2014); the series starts at the launch quarter. Before the EU launch Gentium supplied defibrotide under named-patient programs, which Jazz's line continues to include.
search_log: Listed every Jazz (CIK 1232524) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions; scanned every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2007-05-01 to 2026-11-04 for 'xyrem|defitelio|defibrotide' in table rows and text (bin/scan.py).

Each quarter taken from that quarter's release, row 'Defitelio/defibrotide' (labelled 'Defitelio (defibrotide sodium) / defibrotide' in 2016-Q1 2021) of the net product sales table; in thousands through 2025, in millions from the Q1 2026 release. The 2014 releases also print a second Defitelio/defibrotide row with Gentium's 2013 figures as comparison; the row used is the reported (GAAP) row with '—' prior-year column.
